screens.name: pq-editor-queries
steps: Open C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep03\src\ContosoSales.pbip; if the Formula.Firewall or privacy-level prompt appears set the folder source to Organizational (File > Options and settings > Data source settings), then Refresh
